profile.headline: Innovator and Software Engineer at Leidos
profile.geoLocationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
profile.summary:
•	Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), Cyber Security
•	IoT, Embedded systems development, Linux development, Android system software
•	Programming Languages: Python, LUA, Bash, C, C++
•	Linux Daemons/Utilities: quagga, asterisk, openvpn, openssl, snmpd, ntpd, tftpd-hpa, iproute2, net-tools, bridge-utils, vlan, iptables, gstreamer 
•	Linux distributions: Ubuntu, Fedora, CentOS, Arago, Angstrom
•	Experience with Cisco routers, Cisco switches, and IP Network design/implementation
•	Bilingual: English and Spanish (write, read, speak fluently)
•	Active Department of Defense (DOD) Secret Clearance

positions.title: Researcher/Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions applied to network security in Internet-of-Things (IoT). 
●Defined experiments to evaluate relevant AI models for network security needs. 
●Trained AI models to use network and RF metrics to predict events. 
●Developed an AI-based application to detect intrusions and denial of service attacks. 
●Implemented test-bed setup for experimenting with AI models performance in an IoT network.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Work as technical lead and software architect on a hardware/software platform that operates as a data 
hub and IoT network services ecosystem for tactical and public safety solutions. 
● Developed custom embedded system integrating LTE, WiFi, Bluetooth, Ethernet, USB Type-C, 
HDMI, audio/video, CAN, and an Android SMARC module. 
● Researched and selected Ethernet switch IC. Collaborated with team to select processor and 
peripherals. 
● Created custom Linux distribution and Board-Support-Package (BSP) using Yocto. 
● Developed and integrated Linux drivers for supported interfaces. 
● Implemented Bluetooth device specifications and drivers integration for custom Android image 
(Android Open Source Project). 
● Designed a distributed Python framework to provide system services: abstraction layers for 
configuration management, remote control, IoT sensors. 
● Built a web interface for status reports and device management. 
● Completed prototype and board bring-up 6x faster than company standards.

positions.title: Systems Engineering/Electrical Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on four Linux-based tactical network and communications products for national and international defense systems solutions.
•	Served as Lead Software Designer for a Radio Over IP gateway that provides a seamless audio and data interface between radios, telephony, and IP services.
  ••	Envisioned a product idea. Prototyped a demo (on my own time) by modifying hardware from existing products. Pitched to management and project was funded.
•	Worked with an outsource company to develop a rugged tactical server (C4ISR) that combines a network router, Ethernet switch, USB host, multipurpose serial ports, CAN bus, VoIP call manager, and video encoder in a single platform.
•	Provided product development support for a Vehicular Intercom System that serves analog voice, VoIP, data communication and integration with HF, VHF, UHF radios, and BGAN satellite communications technology.
  ••	Constructed a network application for information retrieval and remote control of Harris radios and CAN bus devices.
•	Developed a wideband tactical ISR/SA video receiver. 
  ••	Ported a QNX-based operating environment to Linux. Replaced system-specific middleware for memory-mapped I/O and other system calls.
  ••	Created gstreamer API to transcode video streams to different format and sizes. Incorporated video hardware acceleration, and power management optimization.
•	Managed, configured, and created test scenarios for Linux network applications and system utilities including quagga, asterisk, openvpn, snmpd, tftpd-hpa, ntpd, iptables, and iproute2.
•	Architected IP network systems solutions for network services. Assured interoperability with CISCO ecosystems and other commercial products.
•	Standardized procedures for development, maintenance, and dependency management using git, Yocto environment, and Agile software development.
•	Helped launch and promote the Internet-Standard Protocol Review Board, which standardizes SNMP practices, and development procedures across company products.

positions.title: Electrical Engineer - Rotational Engineering Program
positions.description:
Selected to participate in a multi-faceted rotational leadership program focused on the Engineering Product Life-cycle covering the areas of Design, Manufacturing, Reliability & Testing, and Product Service.
•	Design Rotation: Tactical Net Forming RF waveform– set up and executed quality tests for 10 and 30 node networks. Modified test scripts; parsed and analyzed results. Supported internal training.
•	MFG. Rotation: Surface Mounted Technology– assigned with the task of reflow oven thermal profiling (temperature and airflow) for SnPb and Pb Free PCB soldering processes. RF shield characterization and PCB assessment to identify cost reduction opportunities. IPC-A-610 Certified.
•	Reliability Rotation: Reliability Engineering – set up and executed the following tests on Harris products: Field Testing, Drop Testing, Leakage Testing, HALT, and MTBF predictions, HAAS.
•	Product Rotation: Product Service– Supported the order management process from the customer order request to the product handling and shipping (Mercury web-based).  Troubleshot, repaired and tested customer owned equipment, PWBs and HF/VHF/UHF radios. Solved problems from customer calls and emails.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research - Hyperspectral Imaging/Rank Order Filter Implementation
positions.description:
•	Developed an algorithm to reduce the time and processing requirements for Hyperspectral Images.
•	Designed, characterized, and manufactured a programmable ROF integrated circuit for testing and implementation.
•	Conducted research related to remote sensing, Hyperspectral Image Processing and programmable Rank Order Filters (ROF) “Winner Takes All” (WTA) configuration.

positions.title: Electrical Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Space Shuttle launch and support, problem solving and database development.
•	Performed research for studies and information related to Space Shuttle project requirements and procedures.
•	Circuit Analysis simulation and design.

positions.title: Student Assistant
positions.description:
•	Thoroughly investigated Hydro-Estimator validations.
•	Gathered historical rainfall data from the Mayagüez area.
•	Checked accuracy and precision of Hydro-Estimator satellite.
•	Communicated results on NOAA CREST symposiums.
